verdict.rationale: Whisper runs headlessly from the command line through a pip-installable `whisper` CLI and a Python API. The hosted API also has an `openai audio:transcriptions create` CLI command that returns JSON, so it can be scripted for automation. The evidence never shows CI use, and community reports note that larger models are impractically slow on CPU-only machines, which typical CI runners are. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation or examples, guidance on non-interactive auth and exit codes, and independent reports of running in CI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The following command will transcribe speech in audio files, using the `turbo` model: whisper audio.flac audio.mp3 audio.wav --model turbo
The model returns the transcript and the detected languages as JSON
